dedupe_keys.name: crop2ml and pycrop2ml framework for exchanging and reusing crop model components across platforms agricultural model exchange initiative

description: Crop2ML is an open framework that describes crop model components in a platform-neutral metalanguage so they can be shared between crop modelling platforms, and PyCrop2ML is its Python library. The Zenodo records say Crop2ML v1.0.0 (28 June 2020, MIT licence) was the first release of the metalanguage for component specification, proposed by the Agricultural Model Exchange Initiative, and that PyCrop2ML v1.2.0 (29 May 2023, CeCILL-C) turns high-level component descriptions into platform-compliant code and adds reverse engineering: it parses components written in Python, R, Java, C++, C# and Fortran with the ANTLR parser generator and produces Crop2ML models. It was tested on an energy balance component from BioMA and soil temperature components from SIMPLACE and DSSAT, and extended to STICS, OpenAlea and SiriusQuality. Authors come from INRAE, CIRAD, the University of Bonn, CREA, the European Commission JRC, Wageningen University, CSIRO and the University of Florida. Both are free source code ZIP downloads (0.9 MB and 3.8 MB). Coverage is any crop model. Caveats: component coverage depends on what has been translated so far. For simulation it lets soil, water and crop growth components move between platforms, so farm models can be coupled to hydrology or energy models. Related catalogue records include DSSAT, STICS and APSIM.
